selectionDisclosure: Trial 15 is a new numbered candidate selected only after Trial 14 development was observed. The candidate is exactly the already-reported Trial 14 formationLiquidityTop3StaticBuyHold comparator; no Trial 15 final-holdout row has been observed at freeze time. The untouched 2026-01-01 through 2026-08-01 holdout is the one-shot confirmation set.

universe.ranking: descending median 2022 daily USDT quote volume with the already-frozen identity-stability exclusion rule

portfolio.entry: single entry at the first available Binance UTC daily open at or after the evaluation start
portfolio.valuation: daily close after entry; ending positions remain open and are marked at the last valid pre-boundary close

costModel.note: Use the same conservative inherited TheOldTrader spot execution assumptions as Trial 14. The single-entry evaluator uses the inherited simulator exactly; no maker-cost assumption is introduced.

finalHoldout.dataSource: checksum-verified Binance Vision daily spot archives through the frozen identity-clean adapter

required: final-holdout Sharpe greater than the 15%-exposure BTC buy-and-hold comparator
final-holdout maximum drawdown no worse than -35%
no one selected asset contributes more than 70% of positive marked portfolio contribution across development plus final
no data-integrity exception, identity instability, out-of-universe substitution, interpolation, or post-2022 ranking change
promotionCriteria.decision: Every required criterion must pass. Failure freezes Trial 15 as a failed trial and does not authorize a parameter rescue. Passing authorizes a separate paper-baseline promotion only, never real-money trading.
